question: What re-scoped research question yields a defensible contribution after the closest work, and which of the candidate re-scopings is most valuable and most feasible?
description: Given that arxiv:2609.12230 appears to report the combined recipe and its comparative claim, continuing the original idea unchanged would likely be a replication. The defensible re-scoped questions (component-wise decomposition with matched-token controls; generalization beyond disease-specific KGs; distinguishing repair's real effect from validation-set cleaning; whether lower-hop RL transfers with seed-level significance) have not been ranked, and the decision of what to pursue is still open.
rationale: Direction choice shapes every downstream step (which papers to compare, which experiment to plan); without ranking the re-scopings, the investigation risks planning experiments that merely reproduce known results. This uncertainty should be resolved after the overlap and confounding questions are investigated.
resolution: The overlap and confounding evidence now ranks the re-scopings: the highest-value, still-unreported questions are (i) matched-token/matched-example isolation of passage locality from supervision volume, (ii) an untouched held-out evaluation set that the repair loop cannot edit, and (iii) a context-size sweep testing the inverted-U; generalization to standard benchmarks is downgraded because standard KGs lack the passage provenance the mechanism needs (U010), and reproducing the 14B pipeline is limited by absent code (U004). The remaining open decision is whether to pursue the decomposition on a reduced-scope setting or to abandon the direction.
